name: Compaction Context Preserve
description: Preserves critical context like current task, modified files, and decisions during conversation compaction to prevent context loss
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Preserve critical context during compaction
CONTEXT_FILE="/tmp/claude-session-context"
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
# Save current working state
if [[ ! -f "$CONTEXT_FILE" ]] || [[ $(find "$CONTEXT_FILE" -mmin +5 2>/dev/null) ]]; then
  {
    echo "=== Session Context ($(date)) ==="
    echo "Project: $ROOT"
    echo "Branch: $(git -C "$ROOT" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "Modified files:"
    git -C "$ROOT" diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -10
    echo "Recent commits:"
    git -C "$ROOT" log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null
  } > "$CONTEXT_FILE" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit 0
